def read_numbers(raw_line):
    parts = raw_line.strip().split()
    return [int(x) for x in parts if x]

def sliding_mean_v2(arr, k):
    # переименование + лишний print и перестановка
    n = len(arr)
    ans = []
    for pos in range(n - k + 1):
        sub = arr[pos:pos + k]
        avg = sum(sub) / k
        ans.append(avg)
    return ans
